info.name: UPS Time In Transit
info.description:
Gives customer's the ability to determine the delivery time for UPS services.

Visit the full [UPS Time In Transit Documentation](https://developer.ups.com/api/reference?loc=en_US#tag/TimeInTransit_other) for more details!

exec: // Get token from globals if collection variable is empty
console.log(svc.serviceLevelDescription + ": " + svc.businessTransitDays + " business days, delivery " + svc.deliveryDate);

header.description: An identifier unique to the request

request.description: This HTTP POST request will return a list of services and the time those services will take to move a package from a given origin to a given destination. Package details provided will sometimes change what services are available for a given lane (origin-destination pair).

response.name: Time In Transit Success
